name: What is the difference between SEO and general website optimization?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between SEO and general website optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is a crucial component of general website optimization, focusing specifically on improving your website's visibility in search engine results. This involves keyword research, technical SEO, content optimization, and link building. General website optimization is a broader concept that encompasses SEO but also includes other critical areas like user experience (UX) design, website speed optimization, mobile responsiveness, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and overall site architecture. While SEO gets your site found, comprehensive website optimization ensures visitors have a positive experience and convert into customers.
acceptedAnswer.description: SEO focuses on search engine visibility, while general website optimization includes SEO plus user experience, site speed, and conversion rate improvements.
